summary: End-to-end frontend test of Admin Panel Section 1 (Currencies & Exchange) + full Exchange feature. Ran 43 assertions across admin panel tiles, wallets modal, USD/TRY rate modals, exchange flow, transactions filters, and admin exchange-log. 36/43 passed. Data persistence in localStorage is 100% correct (verified via readback and post-relogin admin view). However TWO React state-refresh bugs are blocking the user-facing UX: (1) After clicking Save in the admin Wallets modal the amount display keeps showing the OLD value (0) until the modal is closed & reopened; (2) After a successful exchange the user is redirected to /app/home but the wallet cards still show STALE balances (pre-exchange) until a manual reload — because executeExchange writes localStorage but never calls setCurrent on the auth context. Everything else (rates modals, defaults, quote calc, confirmation, atomic swap, no-counterparty rule, 4-tab filter, admin log entry with user name + amounts, admin wallet delta) works correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: After clicking [data-testid=admin-wallet-save-<CUR>], the displayed [data-testid=admin-wallet-amt-<CUR>] does NOT update to the newly saved value — it continues to render the pre-edit value (0 for a fresh admin). Data IS persisted (visible on /app/home wallet-SYP=1,000,000 and after reopening the modal admin-wallet-amt-USD=5,050 later). Root cause: setAdminWallet() in AuthContext writes localStorage but never calls setCurrent(), and the modal reads current.wallets[cur] from the useAuth() state. Only the onClose handler calls updateUser({}) which finally refreshes the auth state.

After exchange-confirm-ok fires and navigate('/app/home') runs, wallet cards ([data-testid=wallet-USD], [data-testid=wallet-SYP]) render STALE balances (USD=100, SYP=0) even though localStorage.trycash_current_user is correctly updated to {USD:50, SYP:650000}. Reproduces every time. A manual page reload fixes the display. Root cause: executeExchange in AuthContext writes to localStorage AND to trycash_current_user but the React AuthProvider's `current` state (useState) is never re-read from localStorage. Nothing calls setCurrent(updatedUser).

integration_issues.issue: State-only UI refresh missing. Persistence, atomic wallet math (user -50 USD, +650,000 SYP; admin +50 USD, -650,000 SYP), transaction records, admin log entry, and privacy rule (no counterparty on user side) all work correctly — verified via localStorage readback and admin re-open. The gap is purely in-React state hydration.

action_items: FIX HIGH — setAdminWallet() in /app/frontend/src/contexts/AuthContext.jsx must also refresh the React state when the acting session is the admin. Simplest patch: after writing to localStorage, if cur.email === ADMIN_EMAIL, call an exposed setter or expose a refreshCurrent() helper from AuthProvider that re-reads AUTH_KEY into `current`. Currently only the onClose handler triggers updateUser({}) which masks the bug on modal close but not while the modal is still open.

FIX HIGH — executeExchange() in /app/frontend/src/contexts/AuthContext.jsx must update the React `current` state of the acting user. Options: (a) return the fresh user object and have AppExchange call updateUser(res.updatedUser) before navigate, or (b) expose a refreshCurrent() from the context and call it inside executeExchange, or (c) convert executeExchange to a method on AuthProvider that calls setCurrent(u). Right now the redirect to /app/home shows stale wallet numbers until a full page reload.
OPTIONAL — Consider a single centralized 'refreshCurrentUserFromStorage()' hook exported from AuthContext to cover any future direct-localStorage mutation (setAdminWallet, executeExchange, etc.).
OPTIONAL — updateUser({}) trick used at modal-close is a code smell; replace with an explicit refreshCurrent().
critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext.jsx mixes React state (useState `current`) with direct localStorage mutators (setAdminWallet, executeExchange, addTx). Any mutator that touches the ACTING user MUST also update `current` via setCurrent — otherwise UI is silently stale. Right now only login/register/updateUser do that.
executeExchange returns { ok, updatedUser } but no caller uses updatedUser. Consumers should either receive it in the return or the context must own the state update.
AdminPanel.jsx line 204: onClose={() => { setModal(null); refresh(); updateUser({}); }} — calling updateUser with empty patch to force a re-hydrate is a code smell; expose a proper refresh helper.
AppExchange.jsx line 135 uses useMemo(() => getRates(), []) — rates array will not react to admin editing rates while the exchange screen is open. Acceptable but worth noting.
AdminPanel L10-75: three near-duplicate localization dictionaries in the same file; hoist to i18n resources (already flagged in iteration 2).

success_rate.frontend: 84% (36/43 assertions). All 7 failures trace to just 2 root causes — both React state-refresh bugs. Underlying data persistence is 100% correct.

When retesting after fix, focus on: (1) admin-wallet-amt-<CUR> should IMMEDIATELY reflect saved value while modal is still open, (2) after exchange-confirm-ok + navigate('/app/home') the wallet-USD and wallet-SYP tiles should show the new values WITHOUT a manual reload. For exchange leg, seed a user then click btn-exchange → fill 50 → submit → confirm and immediately read wallet-USD without reload.

bug_1.title: Admin wallet save shows stale amount in modal
bug_1.reproduction: Fresh admin login → /app/admin → click btn-manage-wallets → click admin-wallet-edit-SYP → type 1000000 → click admin-wallet-save-SYP
bug_1.actual: admin-wallet-amt-SYP still renders '0'; only after closing and reopening the modal does it show '1,000,000'
bug_1.root_cause: AuthContext.setAdminWallet() writes localStorage but does not call setCurrent(). WalletsModal reads current.wallets[cur] from stale React state.
bug_1.fix_hint: In setAdminWallet, if the current session user is admin, also update AuthProvider state. Cleanest: expose a `refreshCurrent()` from useAuth and call it from AdminPanel's save handler.

bug_2.title: User wallet stale after exchange redirect
bug_2.reproduction: As non-admin user with USD=100 → /app/exchange → type 50 → submit → confirm → auto-redirect to /app/home
bug_2.actual: wallet-USD = 100, wallet-SYP = 0 (until manual page reload); localStorage.trycash_current_user IS correct.
bug_2.root_cause: AuthContext.executeExchange() writes localStorage AUTH_KEY but never triggers setCurrent on AuthProvider; consumers don't consume `updatedUser` returned.
bug_2.fix_hint: Return updatedUser and have AppExchange call updateUser(updatedUser) before navigate, OR make executeExchange a method inside AuthProvider that owns setCurrent.
